$comment: Autonomous-build ledger. Anthropic long-running-agent harness pattern. EXAMPLE for a fictional habit tracker ('Habitude') shipping an iOS app, an API and a marketing site — see components.example.json. /onboard generates the real features.json at the repo root from the PRD. One entry per FR; `components` lists the component ids the feature touches, first = where the evidence is captured; passes flips to true only when the evidence file exists in evidence/ (bare path here, as in F-001; the justification goes in PROGRESS.md).

features.title: Create a habit
features.description: From the home screen, the user can create a habit with a name and a repeat schedule (daily or specific weekdays); the new habit appears in the home list immediately.

features.title: Check off today
features.description: The user can mark a habit as done for today with one tap on its row; the row shows a completed state and the action can be undone the same day.

features.title: Habits CRUD endpoints
features.description: The API exposes authenticated create, read, update and delete endpoints for habits, returning validation errors with a stable error shape and rejecting requests for other users' habits.

features.title: Account sign-up
features.description: A new user can create an account from the app; the API issues a session token and the app lands on an empty home list ready for the first habit.

features.title: Streak counter
features.description: Each habit row shows its current streak (consecutive scheduled days completed); the streak increments on check-off and resets to zero when a scheduled day passes without completion.

features.title: Landing page with App Store CTA
features.description: The marketing site presents the product above the fold with a primary call to action linking to the App Store listing; the page is responsive and scores at least 90 on Lighthouse performance.

features.title: Multi-device sync
features.description: Habits and completions sync across the user's devices; a change made on one device appears on another within a minute when both are online, with offline changes merged on reconnect.

features.title: Home screen widget
features.description: A home screen widget shows today's habits and their completion state; tapping the widget opens the app on the home list.
